name: Bridge entry to client
info:
Converts a bridge entry into the target client's POST body format.
Routes by `msg.entry.metadata.target.client_system`.

### Input
`msg.entry` = Entry with Metadata

### WaSOS output
`{ content, callsign: "[source:name] author", isLocation: false, replyMessageId: null, files: [] }`

### Rayvn output
`{ text: "[source:name] author: text", keyEvent: false, releasedInfo: false, loggedByFullName, labels: [], files }`

### File handling
For Rayvn: files with `context_key` have their buffer attached via
`global.get("files.key")`. The buffer travels with the message to
`POST to Rayvn log` which performs the actual upload API call.
